Q: Why did the width collapse in the percentage width child element in an absolutely positioned parent on Internet Explorer 7? I have an absolutely positioned div containing several children, one of which is a relatively positioned div. When I use a percentage-based width on the child div, it collapses to 0 width on IE7, but not on Firefox or Safari.
If I use pixel width, it works. If the parent is relatively positioned, the percentage width on the child works.

*

*Is there something I'm missin
